description: A detector class for linting test method naming conventions in Android projects, checking for 'test' prefix removal and 'given_when_then' format adherence.

classes.name: TestMethodNameDetector
classes.description: A lint detector class that checks for naming patterns in test methods, specifically for prefix 'test' removal and 'given_when_then' format compliance.

methods.name: applicableAnnotations
methods.description: Returns list of annotations this detector applies to, specifically 'org.junit.Test'.

methods.name: visitAnnotationUsage
methods.description: Called when an applicable annotation is used; triggers detection of prefix and format issues in test methods.

methods.name: isAndroidTest
methods.description: Checks if the current file path indicates an Android test ('androidTest' directory).

methods.name: detectPrefix
methods.description: Detects if a test method name starts with 'test' and suggests removal.

methods.name: detectFormat
methods.description: Checks if Android test method names follow the 'given_when_then' or 'when_then' format.
